import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_55/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_55/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_55/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length4_55/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION all source tables (concatenate)
union_df = pd.concat([source0, source1, source2, source3], ignore_index=True)

# GROUP BY WarNum and aggregate min of WhereFought
target_df = union_df.groupby('WarNum', as_index=False)['WhereFought'].min()

# Ensure the column types match target schema: WarNum and WhereFought as integers
target_df['WarNum'] = target_df['WarNum'].astype(int)
target_df['WhereFought'] = target_df['WhereFought'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_55/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# UNION all source tables (concatenate)
df_union = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3], ignore_index=True)

# GROUP BY WarNum and aggregate WhereFought by min to enforce key uniqueness and match target FD
